# Block `figure`

**Use:** An image that is already in the content's figures/ folder.

**Avoid:** Images you cannot point at a real file; generated courses do not have figures yet.

## Example

```json
{
  "kind": "figure",
  "src": "diagram.png",
  "alt": "Diagram of the three-tier architecture",
  "width": 1200,
  "height": 800,
  "caption": "Three-tier architecture.",
  "source": [
    {
      "file": "slides.pdf",
      "page": 4
    }
  ]
}
```

## Fields

| Field | Type | Required |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `kind` | `"figure"` | yes |
| `source` | array of object (1–5) | no |
| `source[].file` | string | yes |
| `source[].page` | integer (≤ 9007199254740991) | yes |
| `src` | string | yes |
| `alt` | string | yes |
| `width` | integer (≤ 9007199254740991) | yes |
| `height` | integer (≤ 9007199254740991) | yes |
| `caption` | string | no |

Every block may carry `source`: 1–5 `{ "file", "page" }` references to the material it came from.
